request.prompt:
subject_definitions
<Subject 1> is the adult ceramic artist with short dark curly hair, trimmed beard and rust-colored linen shirt in <Picture 1>.

summary
[reference generation] A five-second portrait of <Subject 1> forming a small friendly smile in his bright pottery studio.

retention_analysis
<Subject 1> (throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - Retain his recognizable face, hairstyle, beard and linen shirt, with the softly lit pottery studio from the reference.

detailed_description
[Shot 1] Begin with the relaxed mid-torso portrait composition in <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> looks at the camera with a neutral expression, gradually forms a small closed-mouth smile, and holds it for the last second. His head and shoulders stay relaxed and nearly still. The complete head, both shoulders and space above the hair remain visible. The camera stays fixed at eye level in one continuous shot. Soft daylight remains steady; quiet studio room tone is heard. No dialogue, writing, captions or cuts.

overall_soundscape
Quiet steady indoor room ambience with a faint breeze outside the window, no speech or sudden impacts.

non_diegetic_music
None.

tests.preparation: Native scalar merge oracle and stored W8G64 codes/scales/biases matched on208projections x13rows; public verified local reuse passed.

review_scope: Methods disclosed. Every120-frame sequence sheet and original frames23,71,119; no subjective listening or normal-speed playback qualification.
timing_scope: Core pairs include native inputs, planning, sampling, X2 and mux. Installed calls additionally include ordinary setup and worker startup, excluding one-time preparation. One run per arm; not a sustained speedup estimate.
retained_failures: Old calibration runtime-adapter output duplicates the subject; candidate removes that failure.

First installed baseline generated successfully; a validation-script KeyError on removed workspace metadata lost its external timer. Preserved media exactly replays the baseline; excluded from timing, rerun under the same frozen request.
First portrait core baseline overlapped2.09s of CPU unit tests; its2.4percent difference is not a speedup claim.
limitations: Two new references, one seed each, five seconds. No universal duplicate-free or exact identity guarantee.
Small-face softness, background reconstruction and camera movement remain.
The causal intervention is adapter preparation order/rounding. No proven SOL attention-kernel or adapter-factor binding defect.
Earlier VSA/native768p speed studies use different recipes and cannot supply a new speedup claim for this candidate.
